一句话作用: Remote-control tmux sessions for interactive CLIs by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output.
关键输入: - Literal sends: tmux -S "$SOCKET" send-keys -t target -l -- "$cmd" - Control keys: tmux -S "$SOCKET" send-keys -t target C-c
关键输出: - Capture recent: tmux -S "$SOCKET" capture-pane -p -J -t target -S -200 - Wait for prompts: {baseDir}/scripts/wait-for-text.sh -t session:0.0 -p 'pattern'
